newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi urges world to save Mideast peace process.
newsitem.headline: Saudi urges world to save Mideast peace process.

text.p: King Fahd of Saudi Arabia on Monday urged the international community to do its utmost to save the stalled Middle East peace process, the official Saudi press agency SPA said.

"His majesty urged the international community and all peace-loving nations to exert sincere efforts to save the peace process from the deteriorating situation it has reached because of Israel's intransigence...," it said.
The remarks were made to SPA by Saudi Information Minister Fouad bin Abdul-Salam bin Mohammad Farsi after a weekly cabinet meeting chaired by king Fahd.
Israel's groundbreaking of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March has plunged Middle East peacemaking into crisis.
